STEP 1 — prescreening: For each element, annotate referential:
y = this element is a referential expression (NP, pronoun) that can enter coreference
n = this element cannot participate; it will be EXCLUDED from the pair list in Step 2
When finished, mark prescreening as "ready-for-review" in the Status tab. The coordinator will then regenerate each pair construction tab from the prescreening results.
STEP 2 — (pair constructions): Do NOT annotate until the coordinator confirms regeneration. The coordinator runs:

Each row (Element_A, Position_A, Position_B, Direction) represents a potential antecedent-anaphor pair. Position columns use "N (name)" format e.g. "5 (v:npsubj1)". For reflexivization:   mark reflexive_allowed=y if a reflexive at Position_B can be
bound by Element_A at Position_A; n if it cannot. (Principle A)
For pronominalization: mark pronoun_allowed=y if a pronoun at Position_B can be
bound by Element_A at Position_A; n if it cannot. (Principle B)
For np_reference:      mark np_allowed=y if an NP at Position_B can corefer with
Element_A at Position_A; n if it cannot. (Principle C)
